about: Every change made to the owner's copy of sanskritdocuments.org's text (scriptures-data: printouts/sanskritdocuments/bhagavad-gita.json), with its reason; read by make_text.py. reconciliation.md explains each.

2.64: the copy's variant reading in brackets is not text (fix, don't annotate); its own reading stays
8.9: अणीयांसम् (accusative of अणीयस्, 'subtler'): अणीयंसम् is not a word; the witness and the metre agree
11.46: a final m before a vowel is joined to it (चक्रहस्तमिच्छामि), written across the line as the copy does in 8.9
12.2: श्रद्धया परयोपेताः ते मे युक्ततमा मताः ॥
visarga before त is स् (उपेतास्ते), as the witness reads
15.3: a final m before a vowel is joined to it (सुविरूढमूलमसङ्गशस्त्रेण), written across the line as the copy does in 8.9
17.23: a missing space: ॐ is a word of its own, as in every colophon

15: an extra space; the compound as in the other seventeen colophons
18: the vowels are joined by sandhi, as in नामाष्टमोऽध्यायः (8) and नामैकादशोऽध्यायः (11)
